full_original_model: 0.25-second original Q time graph, 418 source vehicle ODs, uniform 14400 release steps; original capacity/cost/wait/turn/sink

algorithm_policy.initial_columns: none; new source AON/FIFO feasible base algebraic
algorithm_policy.partial_pricing: All original OD/release events represented: FIFO-managed OD through partition fragments; every other OD through its exact AON base event. Under zero capacity and group prices, unfragmented free-flow AON events have provably zero reduced cost and are skipped only in that round. Otherwise all 6,019,200 original events are priced in destination streams.
algorithm_policy.center_update: same-run 0.5 old center + 0.5 true RMP price; on no useful partial column alpha increases by 0.15 up to 1 and exact full price is invoked
algorithm_policy.selection: Full original-event exact oracle: OD/window diverse top 320. Separately source-only FIFO weighted-wait bridge: exact fixed-service original-graph prefix, positive source raw saving, OD/window diverse top 320. All complete paths evaluated by same current joint RMP true reduced cost.
algorithm_policy.column_identity: Source fragment or unsplit original OD/release key plus full original edge/time path; one shared group demand and original capacity row system across both candidate lanes.
algorithm_policy.exact_closure: Full 418 x 14400 original time graph price under final true RMP dual and independent Bellman audit; no partial-pricing closure claim.
algorithm_policy.RMP: One shared joint path master; source bridge is partial candidate lane with 80 reserved negative reduced-cost slots among max 240 new columns, remaining slots global true-dual rank; all original events algebraic.
algorithm_policy.zero_flow: retained in pool; no objective-stagnation stop
algorithm_policy.change_from_dev37: Dev39 full event OD-diverse pricing plus Dev40 exact source-only queued-bridge prefix generator and generic true-dual lane reservation; source graph/demand/capacity/time unchanged.
algorithm_policy.change_from_dev38: Dev39 OD-diverse selection plus Dev40 source bridge lane, no historical flow/columns/duals.
algorithm_policy.source_bridge_rule: maximum mass-weighted wait over fresh FIFO stage edges; source edge ID tie; excludes chosen bridge during exact fixed-time prefix DP

resources.memory_rule: stop on allocation failure; preserve last source-verified stage; no OD/time deletion

acceptance_scope: Cold source-only Urbana F Q development candidate: actual shared joint CG + source bridge multi-pricing. Independent original primal/full graph dual required. Not final 16-case build.
